en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a long, modernist clinic building with tiled facade, stone base and a colonnade of round pillars along the front. Large horizontal windows run across the upper floor, with some open blinds. A 1950s–60s style station wagon and a bus are visible in the foreground, suggesting a hospital or institutional entrance area. The reverse side has printed multilingual text identifying the place as the clinic in Pécs, Hungary, space for address and message, and publisher/pricing information.
